name: White Bean, Asparagus & Mushroom Sauté over Parmesan Polenta
ingredients: 16 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth
instructions: Medium dice polenta; place in a large pot along with broth, salt, and pepper. Bring to a simmer over medium-high heat.

Once the broth is simmering, reduce heat to medium. Using a potato masher, mash the polenta until smooth; continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until heated through, 2-3 minutes more. Remove from heat and cover to keep warm.
Meanwhile, wash, dry, and snap (or cut) off woody ends of the asparagus; cut spears into 1-inch pieces.
Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, peel and mince garlic.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add asparagus, garlic, mushrooms, and spices. Cook, stirring occasionally, until veggies are tender, 4-5 minutes.
Meanwhile, drain and rinse beans in a colander.
Add beans and vinegar to the skillet. Continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until beans are warmed through, 2-3 minutes. Remove from heat.
Add Parmesan to the pot with the polenta and stir to combine.
To serve, divide polenta between plates or bowls; top with bean and veggie sauté. Sprinkle with basil and enjoy!
author: Mealime
